function.name: get_mol_properties_and_fg
function.description: Return plain-text single-molecule property evidence. The tool outputs one line per dense property in 'display_name: value' form for the 36 default dense properties, followed by the molecule's present functional groups and their counts. When the strongest acidic pKa or strongest basic pKa is undefined, the text explicitly says 'not applicable (no acidic/basic site)'.

smiles.description: SMILES string for the molecule to analyze.
